lede: Missouri carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.8 against +5.2, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Missouri -1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Missouri winning 51% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Missouri leads Florida by 91 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
